H2_calibration.quote: The general savings statute (1 U.S.C. § 109) addresses repeals, but its application to expiring statutes is less settled.
H2_calibration.note: Also: 'Congress could always do that anyway, so the "off-ramp" adds little legally.'

H4_grandfather_step.quote: A developer could start a nominal training run just before enactment and keep scaling it afterward.
